answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Diamond sorter faceted gem mark witnessed by the carvers hall. It requires each faceted gem is a wax seal pressed beside the cutters mark, so a farm must sort a hundred real diamonds by hand, so the garden of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the jade first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The sonnet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
